title: Efficient difference-in-differences estimation under partial interference with incremental propensity score policies
abstract: arXiv:2607.19925v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops efficient difference-in-differences (DID) estimation under partial interference with a cluster incremental propensity score (CIPS) policy. We define direct and spillover average treatment effects on the treated, establish their identification, and derive their efficient influence functions, from which we construct a cross-fitted estimator. Simulations evaluate its finite-sample performance. An application to China's New Rural Pension Scheme recovers the reduction in farmwork among pension recipients reported by the original county-level analysis, separately estimates a within-household spillover alongside the direct effect, and traces both effects across the policy parameter.

translated_title: 部分干扰下基于集群增量倾向得分政策的双重差分有效估计
translated_abstract: 本文在集群增量倾向得分（CIPS）政策下的部分干扰情境中，发展了有效的双重差分（DID）估计方法。我们定义了处理组的直接效应与溢出平均处理效应，建立了二者的识别条件，并推导出其有效影响函数，据此构造了交叉拟合估计量。仿真实验评估了该估计量的有限样本表现。在中国新型农村社会养老保险的实证应用中，该方法重现了原县级分析所报告的养老金领取者务农减少的结果，同时分别估计出家庭内部溢出效应与直接效应，并追踪了两种效应随政策参数的变化轨迹。
tldr: 本文在部分干扰与集群增量倾向得分政策下提出有效的双重差分估计方法，通过推导有效影响函数构造交叉拟合估计量，实现对处理组直接效应与溢出效应的分离识别，并成功应用于中国新农保政策的家庭内溢出效应评估。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an efficient difference-in-differences estimator under partial interference with a cluster incremental propensity score policy, deriving efficient influence functions to construct a cross-fitted estimator that separately identifies direct and spillover effects on the treated, applied to China's New Rural Pension Scheme.
